sample_unit: guideline-derived clinical questions (each queried in English and Chinese, 3 responses per model)

links.outcome: Calibrated uncertainty expression in guideline-defined uncertainty domains
links.effect: Models gave consistently overconfident responses in domains where the guidelines define evidence as uncertain, described as an important safety limitation.
links.quote: Advanced LLMs show potential for supporting sepsis fluid therapy guideline interpretation, but consistent overconfident responses in guideline-defined uncertainty domains highlight important safety limitations.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, completeness, and readability of LLMs (ChatGPT and DeepSeek) answering clinical questions derived from sepsis guidelines, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
